title: Functional Materials & Devices
short: Materials chosen for what they do: sense, switch, store, actuate and convert.
overview: Functional materials are valued for electrical, magnetic, optical or chemical behaviour rather than load-bearing strength. Research in this area includes dielectric, ferroelectric and piezoelectric materials, permanent magnets and magnetic shape memory alloys, multiferroics and spintronics, and two-dimensional materials.

Thin films are a recurring platform: grown by sputtering and other deposition methods, then examined by high-resolution electron microscopy and diffraction to link growth conditions to device-relevant properties.
